text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling super tired lately...
Did I do something weird, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, before that was karaoke-hopping with Pokke-chan,
then a race review meeting with Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I scouted my race opponents,
helped out with Tachyon-chan's experiment,
readjusted the training routine for the race...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Today, we'll have a race strategy meeting, do some training...
Ah! Speaking of which, about the next race—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like I pushed her too hard. Let's hold off on racing for a while...
